text:
tom: Heads up 1: planning the social push for launch + webinar across NA/EU/APAC. Need a localized cadence + seeding plan for influencers. Can we map who owns what by EOD?
maya: I'll own NA/X + LinkedIn long-form. Focus on 3 posts (teaser, product highlight, webinar push) over 48h.
evelyn: I'll own EU timing (GMT) and coordinate translations for FR/DE. Short captions only for X, longer for LinkedIn.
kai: I'll take APAC scheduling, need localized copy for JP/KR and times that hit 10:00 JST / 12:00 KST. Also we should avoid Tue morning US posts that crush APAC reach.
sofia: Engagement rules: reply to any question within 45m; top 5 replies get a personalized case study link. For influencers: DM templates ready.
tom: Influencer seeding: list of 8 folks. Plan: 1) soft DM + asset pack, 2) offer promo code for registrants (promo: REDWOOD20), 3) small paid boost on posts that land >500 engagements.
evelyn: For paid boosts, tag ads via `utm_medium=paid_social` and set `utm_content=influencer_{handle}` so we can attribute conversions.
kai: Can we include a localized landing path? Example: `/jp/launch?utm_source=social` so we capture language.
maya: Yes. Also request closed captions & one-sentence TL;DR for each clip for LinkedIn alt text. Design: 1:1, 4:5, 16:9 exports + a square thumbnail.
sofia: Lead routing: HubSpot form name `launch_webinar_global_v2`. For scoring, set lead_score +=20 if utm_medium=paid_social or promo=REDWOOD20. SDRs pinged via Slack `#sdr-inbound` and tag `@sdr-oncall`.
tom: Measurement events (Analytics): `social_click`, `webinar_reg`, `influencer_signup`. Please keep event names exact.
evelyn: Also want a short benchmark narrative for paid posts: baseline CTR (expected) 1.2%, CPA target <$40. I'll draft a 2-paragraph blurb to include in the campaign doc.
kai: Assets: can design deliver transcript SRT for clips? Need for JP subtitles.
maya: I'll queue posts in social-console. Ops-bot, can you confirm available slots?
ops-bot: Available scheduling windows: Mon 17:00 UTC, Tue 16:00 UTC, Wed 09:00 UTC. Carousel uploads remaining: 3.
sofia: Outreach templates (snippet):
- DM: "Hey {name}, launching something that helps teams cut LLM inference cost. Would love to share an early look + a promo code for your audience. Interested?"
- Reply: "Thanks for the interest! Grab the webinar seat: <link>?utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=prod_launch_global"
maya: One more: please include tracking pixel for webinar platform and add `influencer_handle` to the registration payload so we can tie conversions.
tom: Final checklist:
- localization + captions (evelyn/kai)
- influencer outreach + promo code (tom/sofia)
- UTMs + form name + event names (evelyn/sofia)
- assets + SRT (design via maya)
- schedule in console (maya)
Reply when complete and I'll approve the queue. :sparkles:
